claim_tested: AcsD octamer has four internal passageways that bind glucan
key_finding: Source of PDB 3A8E/3AJ1/3AJ2; octameric cylinder, cellopentaose bound; this run re-measured the cavities rather than re-deriving the architecture
confidence: high for the coordinates; the word 'passageway' is a structural description, not a measured conduit

claim_tested: The four passageways are four separate channels open at both ends and coaxial with the cylinder
key_finding: At a 1.4 A water probe the four sites form ONE compartment, 59,359 A^3, 80 A long, open at both ends, Rmax 19.18 A. At a 3.2 A glucan probe they are four closed pockets of 13-17 A^3 and 3.6-4.8 A length. The grooves lie at radius 13.6 A, inclined 42-44 deg, so they are offset and helical, not coaxial.
context: BIOMT biological octamer, 0.4 A grid, scipy.ndimage connected components
confidence: high; depends on the crystallographic coordinates and on a rigid-protein assumption

claim_tested: Local width and burial at the AcsD site distinguish it from a real translocation channel
key_finding: AcsD pore radius 3.8-4.7 A and per-atom burial 0.84-0.87 fall inside the BcsA range (burial 0.43-0.95 along the 18-mer). Width and burial alone cannot separate the two.
context: BcsA-BcsB with an 18-unit nascent glucan, Rhodobacter sphaeroides, as positive control
confidence: high; the metric is calibrated rather than asserted

claim_tested: The lining chemistry is that of a sliding channel with aromatic stacking platforms
key_finding: Zero aromatic residues within 4.5 A of the sugar at all four sites, against 32% aromatic in the BcsA channel lining (Fisher exact p=0.0024). The nearest aromatic is 4.9 A away. The site is Lys6, Lys7, Asp9, Thr11, Leu12, Gln15, Asn61, Ala62, Ala65, Leu66, Ile67, Gly68, Gln92, Gly94 from four subunits.
context: 4.5 A heavy-atom contact shell, 3A8E site F_0
confidence: high; limited by 3.0 A resolution, so individual rotamers are uncertain

claim_tested: The four sites organize chains into a cellulose crystallite
key_finding: Sites are 19.1 A apart centre to centre against 8.20 A for chains in a cellulose I-beta sheet, and chain axes differ by 54.6-58.0 deg (adjacent) and 85.7-86.9 deg (opposite) against 0 deg required for a crystallite.
context: Four distinct cellopentaose sites after removing crystallographic duplicates
confidence: high for the measured geometry; the modelled sugars are a soak, not necessarily four simultaneously occupied sites in vivo

claim_tested: A chain could pass only with conformational change
key_finding: Glucan-lining residues superpose at 0.29-0.44 A between apo and complex, below the 1.12-1.53 A core RMSD. No induced fit is detectable. The rigid-slide test failed to separate AcsD from BcsA and is non-discriminating.
context: Kabsch superposition on residues 20-130, eight chains
confidence: moderate; two crystal forms cannot exclude motions suppressed by lattice contacts

claim_tested: The passageway lining is conserved across the AcsD/BcsD family
key_finding: Lining positions average 0.241 identity versus 0.301 for the rest (Mann-Whitney p=0.31). The 12 most conserved positions (G70 0.97, W115 0.94, P91 0.94, W69 0.94) sit a median 11.0 A from the sugar. Only Asn61 (0.92) is at the site. Lys6, whose region is implicated in yield, is 0.04 across the family and 0.47 among 15 close orthologs.
context: 491 PF03500 sequences, custom Needleman-Wunsch to P37719
confidence: moderate; identity to a single reference, not a curated structural alignment

claim_tested: BcsD acts in the context of the synthase complex
key_finding: BcsD interacts with the BcsAB catalytic core both directly and indirectly, and the interaction is dynamic
context: Gluconacetobacter, in vivo and in vitro interaction analysis
confidence: moderate; supports complex membership, says nothing about passageway transport

claim_tested: BcsD is required wherever bacterial cellulose is made
key_finding: PF03500 spans 141 genera but is absent from Escherichia and Salmonella, which make cellulose without a BcsD subunit
confidence: moderate; Pfam coverage is not a complete genome survey
